candidateRevision: Integrated performance change; source and compiled-tree hashes below identify measured runtime bytes independently of the later documentation commit.

protocol.wall: One whole workload; imports, fixture creation, explicit GC and output assertions excluded.
protocol.cpu: Process user + system CPU during the wall interval, including automatic GC.
protocol.heap: Transient heapUsed after - before, with output alive; not allocation totals, retained heap or peak.
protocol.rss: Process-wide before/after resident bytes, not workload allocation totals or peak.
protocol.maxRss: process.resourceUsage().maxRSS in KiB; process-wide high-water mark including setup.

realBrowser.protocol: Source-loaded registered native extension tools, actual agent-browser 0.38.1 and headless Chrome for Testing 151.0.7922.77 against deterministic loopback fixtures; automatic per-root caller-owned browser, 2 warmups and 15 measured calls per workload per run. Parent CPU excludes native/browser subprocess CPU; wall includes those subprocesses. This is neither full Pi/model latency nor a universal workflow guarantee.

startup.protocol: 15 fresh Node import/factory samples per revision using the canonical startup-measurement owner and the locked 1.0.2 development SDK graph. Optional companion search registration was present on both sides; no search call was made. This timing diagnostic is separate from real latest-official/fork loader qualification. Host-noise ranges overlap; no startup speedup claimed.

ownerMeasurements.note: Captured owner-isolated A/B diagnostics on unchanged adopted algorithms, separate from the final integrated warm/native profiles above. Fake-native spawn counts are causal work counts, not real-browser timings.

nativeSpawnCounts.name: tool warm implicit get title no refs
tool warm implicit get title with refs

electronDiscovery.workload: 120 .app bundles without Electron Framework/payload, 20 complete Electron bundles; sequential real filesystem discovery with unchanged ordering and metadata
electronDiscovery.method: 2 warm scans per version; 11 paired scans alternating A/B order; filesystem async request counts measured separately from timings; every scan checked against independently specified 20-app output

qualityPrefix.workload: actual code-quality.mjs scope/check/lint baseline prefix vs lint-only optimized prefix against identical maintained source/config/checker
qualityPrefix.method: one full warmup; 5 paired runs alternating A/B order; child user/system CPU captured independently; inventories compared structurally; every lint must return zero warnings/errors

preRetention.variant: baseline retention logic with new raw tokenizer; not unchanged baseline commit

ownerMeasurements.storageBreadthProtocol: Fresh processes with --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128; three runs per variant/size. The pre-retention variant combines baseline retention logic with the new raw tokenizer, isolating retention; it is not the unchanged baseline commit. Streaming peak heapUsed is process-wide 1 ms sampling; synchronous pure figures are post-call heapUsed. RSS is process-wide.
ownerMeasurements.timeoutSampling: Process-wide memoryUsage sampling every 1 ms; figures are medians across n runs (n=3 at 1000 paths). Native libuv work/timers overlap; neither heap nor RSS is a per-path allocation total.

rejected.socketTraversal: No-adopt; original sequential validation retained after directory-replacement and native unknown-Dirent fallback controls rejected candidates. No delivered socket gain.
rejected.helperOverwrite: No-adopt; separate dist/packaged helper outputs preserve emitted checkout shared owners. Compiled session/namespace and spill-cleanup regression failed before repair and passed afterward.
rejected.whitespaceOnlyBundle: No demonstrated startup gain beyond measured variation.

limitations: Shared host; load recorded, no isolated-machine claim.
Heap deltas are not retained allocation totals or peaks; RSS is process-wide.
Real-browser loopback measurements do not include model/provider latency.
Windows performance and native qualification not run; owner waiver remains.
No source credentials, personal profiles or page data are included.
